svg.title: SpriteFrames panel and sheet slicer
svg.desc: Proposed editor UI for G2a. Top: the SpriteFrames tab of the bottom panel with the animation list (idle, run, jump, attack; name, frames per second, loop, autoplay badge), the frame strip of the run animation with relative durations, playback and editing icon buttons, a tooltip on "Add frames from a sprite sheet", and a preview. Bottom: the Select Frames dialog slicing hero.png by an 8 by 4 grid with six cells selected in order, the grid controls (horizontal and vertical counts, cell size, separation, offset) and the Add 6 Frames action.
svg.text: SpriteFrames tab (bottom panel, shown for a selected AnimatedSprite2D or an opened SpriteFrames .mres)

Animations: name, FPS, loop; the green badge marks Autoplay.

Animated sprites (proposal G2a). Icon buttons with tooltips throughout; numbered markers are annotations, not UI.
